scope: First-party product-quality acceptance for pm-mcp as a local stdio MCP service on Windows x64 with Node.js 25.8.1; distributable engine floor remains Node.js 22.18. Includes the implemented project brain, strict AST governance for the declared source tree, quality gates, and the recorded 20 GiB synthetic qualification workload. Excludes hosted CI, production HA/DR, independent certification, safety-critical use, and universal runtime execution claims. Historical 20 GiB qualification measurements are retained as dated reference evidence, not a new 0.3.0 performance run. This candidate adds version diagnostics, business pagination, and graded completion evidence; publication and existing-client reconnection are separate operations.

approval.rationale: 用户于2026-09-08要求直接开工执行已提出的前三项升级。本地代理依据该授权采用1.1.0基线，同步0.3.0产品、48工具和Node最低版本22.18；保留其余量化阈值及全部验收要求。原批准1.0.0不变，不代表远程发布授权或独立认证。

stage_results.result_note: Product, intended use, environment and exclusions were frozen in the approved baseline.
Nine characteristics, quantitative requirements, risks, tests and evidence pointers were designed before execution.
Entry, stop, retest and reporting rules were frozen; the readable plan is supplementary evidence.
Earlier failures were preserved without lowering thresholds; current measurements were collected with fresh source-bound quality evidence.
All evidence hashes and frozen JSON assertions are ready for evaluator recomputation and immutable report generation.

characteristic_results.tailoring_reason: This local development-governance tool is not accepted for safety-critical decisions; such use requires a separate hazard analysis and evaluation.
